en.t: I resolved to reveal my true feelings to K.

units.source_text: 不过，这个想法并不是那时才有的。

en.t: But this idea had not first come to me then.

units.source_text: 虽然在这次旅行之前，我就有过这样的打算，

en.t: Even before this trip, I had already been intending to do so,

units.source_text: 只是以我的能耐，一直没能够找到坦白的机会，或者制造出这种机会来。

en.t: but with my limited ability, I had never managed to find a chance to confess it, or to create such a chance myself.

units.source_text: 现在回想起来，那时我周围的人都有点古怪，

en.t: Looking back now, the people around me at that time were all rather strange,

units.source_text: 竟没有一个人愿意多谈及女人。

en.t: and not a single one of them was willing to speak much about women.

units.source_text: 当然大部分人是没有什么可谈的吧，不过即使有，一般也是避而不谈。

en.t: Of course, most of them probably had nothing to talk about, but even when they did, they generally avoided the subject.

units.source_text: 你们生活在今天比较自由的空气中，一定觉得奇怪吧，

en.t: You who live now in a comparatively freer atmosphere must surely find this strange,

units.source_text: 这是道学的影响，还是因为羞于谈论，就只能靠你自己去判断了。

en.t: whether it was the influence of moral doctrine or simply embarrassment about speaking of such things, I must leave for you to judge.

units.source_text: K和我是无话不谈的朋友，

en.t: K and I were friends who could talk about anything,

units.source_text: 虽然偶尔也聊聊恋爱之类的话题，

en.t: and although we would sometimes discuss topics such as love,

units.source_text: 但总是流于抽象的理论，

en.t: the conversation always drifted into abstract theory,

units.source_text: 不过就连这样的谈论也是不多的。

en.t: and even such discussions were rare.

units.source_text: 我们谈论的大多是有关读书和学问、未来的事业以及抱负和修养等等。

en.t: Most of what we talked about concerned books and learning, our future careers, our ambitions, self-cultivation, and the like.

units.source_text: 无论怎样亲密，也不会突然间转换话题谈及情爱的。

en.t: No matter how close we were, we would not suddenly change the subject and speak of love or passion.

units.source_text: 我们俩就是这样一对古板的朋友。

en.t: The two of us were just that sort of stiff and old-fashioned friends.

units.source_text: 自从我打算把小姐的事告诉K以来，

en.t: Ever since I decided to tell K about the young lady,

units.source_text: 不知多少次欲言又止，甚是苦恼。

en.t: I do not know how many times I nearly spoke and then held back, tormented by it.

units.source_text: 我真想在K的脑袋上凿开一个窟窿，给他灌输些温柔的空气进去。

en.t: I truly wanted to bore a hole into K's head and pour a little gentler air into him.
